{{Quote|Cheenee Rift has more holes in it than a chunk of Byss cheese. The Czerka mining complex sits over a network of caverns.|[[Risha Drayen]]|<ref name="TOR:Bait" />}}
The '''Abandoned Czerka Mining Complex''' was [[Mining/Legends|mining]] facility owned by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] in the [[Cheenee Rift]], within the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was abandoned by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR:Bait" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> a group of assassins sequestered [[Audila]] and [[Juran Reb]] in the abandoned mining complex as a bait to draw and assassinate [[Risha Drayen]], a member of the [[Dubrillion/Legends|Dubrillion]] [[Drayen dynasty|roxal family]].<ref name="TOR:Bait" />
